steps.en: Install its two helpers where the target process can import them, and allow ptrace (or run as root)
steps.zh: 把两个辅助库装到目标能 import 的位置，放开 ptrace

steps.en: Point it at the live process by PID
steps.zh: 按 PID 指向那个活进程

steps.en: Attaches GDB and pauses the process and all its threads
steps.zh: 用 GDB 附着，暂停进程及其全部线程

steps.en: Counts live objects per type and their sizes inside the target, saves a snapshot file, releases it
steps.zh: 在目标内部按类型清点活对象和大小，存快照文件，放开进程

steps.en: Some time later, run again against the same PID with the earlier snapshot
steps.zh: 过一段时间，带上前一次快照对同一 PID 再跑

steps.en: Shows a comparison page in its terminal UI: which object types grew in count and size
steps.zh: 在终端界面里给出对比页：哪些类型的数量和大小在涨

value.en: See which object types are leaking inside a running process without adding code, redeploying or restarting it
value.zh: 不加代码、不重新部署、不重启，就能看到一个运行中的进程里哪类对象在泄漏

sources: https://github.com/facebookarchive/memory-analyzer#memory_analyzer (install objgraph and pympler in the target binary's library path; process and all threads paused)
https://github.com/facebookarchive/memory-analyzer#how-to-run (memory_analyzer run $PID; ncurses UI; memory_analyzer_out/ snapshot file; ptrace_scope or root)
https://github.com/facebookarchive/memory-analyzer#comparing-snapshots (memory_analyzer run $PID --snapshot <previous snapshot file>; snapshot page in the UI)
